target.name: lead_time_days
target.cohort: delivered orders with valid non-negative target and available item records
target.missing_target_policy: exclude and count; do not impute

stakeholder.use: estimate purchase-to-receipt duration to support arrival-expectation communication
limits: point prediction does not provide a calibrated arrival interval
historical target is observed only for eligible completed deliveries
prediction quality does not establish causal business impact

data_source: course seven CSV tables reconstructed and reconciled with Phase 1 and shared 00 commit ce57de2ef86ce3e8d887c7703326b1139f95070b
candidate_feature_groups: seller-customer geography and multi-seller state relationship
order-item price, freight, counts and seller counts
feature_schema_status: 16 input fields verified; formulas and roles in config/feature_roles.csv
feature_availability_policy: only inputs available at purchase; original quote availability is an explicit archive assumption
excluded_input_roles: final status and delivery outcome labels
payments or approval recorded after the prediction instant
arbitrary identifiers used as numeric predictors
optional_experiments: Ridge alpha 10/100 assessed after development instability; forest log1p trial not selected by training CV

evaluation.success_criterion: empirical improvement against same-sample reference and simple models, assessed together with robustness and tail behavior
evaluation.split_policy: train: purchase and receipt before 2018-03-01 (53644); validation: March purchases with receipt before 2018-07-01 (7003); April-June maturation gap (19643); July-August locked test (12507); prior pending labels (3673)
evaluation.cross_validation: three expanding chronological folds, label availability before each start; evaluation rows conditional on labels known by 2018-03-01
evaluation.label_availability: each training fold uses only orders whose receipt was observed before its forecast cutoff
evaluation.preprocessing: fit imputation, encoding, scaling and transformations inside training folds
evaluation.test_use: lock during development; joint final evaluation after base-model and stacking designs are frozen

stacking.implementation_scope: handoff only; fitting is a separate integration step
stacking.meta_training: OOF predictions only; no in-sample fitted predictions or test labels
stacking.time_oof_warmup: exclude rows without a valid earlier-trained prediction, consistently across base models
stacking.fitting_scope: four base pipelines fitted on 53644 development training rows; final pre-July refit pending

sharing: Team repository review snapshot: https://github.com/IT5006-Group9/IT5006-Group9-Olist-Project/tree/main/Phase%202; copied from standalone commit 0625de8521097f69e615fea857ded4314a2c9aa5; source, executed notebooks, summary tables, figures and conclusions shared; raw/derived order data, per-order predictions, OOF and fitted models remain local.

data_preparation_audit.recommended_geography: screened deduplicated postal median; preserve orders with missing flag
data_preparation_audit.existing_results: canonical handoff remains legacy v1; separate v2 model review and v3 feature/maturity review complete
data_preparation_audit.handling: retain and flag; non-target event inconsistencies do not establish wrong purchase/receipt timestamps
data_preparation_audit.next_action: review retained candidate design; integrate v2 preparation and mature-CV selection into canonical pipeline/OOF coherently before separate stacking and final testing

model_review.selection: training CV only; March comparison of selected configurations plus fixed original comparators
model_review.conclusion: small gains; bias and slow-order error remain; deeper forests overfit; feature and maturity sensitivity work pending

feature_optimization.development_stages: 10 temporal/history ablations; 6 spline checks; 2 online-history checks; adaptive training-CV-driven development
feature_optimization.selected: previous log-input Ridge alpha1000 and forest with 180-day recency weights; new additions not selected
feature_optimization.limits: mature retrospective labels known before July; completed-delivery conditioning remains; marked online variants only use prior receipt events; adaptive/non-nested selection
